what: 望 (wàng): what is trending in Chinese media right now, translated. A feed to explore. Nothing here is scored or read by Prism.
source: Each platform's own public hot list, read directly by chinavision-pull.py. Not read this time: Zhihu: HTTPError HTTP Error 403: Forbidden.
notesBy: Accounts, quotes and reception are written by local:qwen, on this Mac from the news pages it read. Reception comes from three places, each named beside it: the article itself, the hourly roundup published on Sina, and the top comments under the most-watched videos on Bilibili. What is visible is what was allowed to stay up. Accounts are in its own words; a quote is kept only when it is found exactly in its source and is short. The full texts stay on this Mac (data/chinavision/raw/) and are not shown.

items.zh: 金价
items.en: Gold prices
items.note: International gold prices have fallen below $3,600 an ounce, marking a 14-month low due to a combination of rising US interest rate expectations and selling by institutional investors. Experts attribute this decline to the US dollar strengthening and a shift in market sentiment where liquidity was pulled from gold to cover losses in other assets. Despite the sharp drop, analysts argue that the long-term bullish trend has not ended, citing continued purchases by global central banks as a key support factor.

sources.name: China News Service
sources.title: 黄金跌跌不休，何时反弹？
sources.titleEn: Gold prices continue to fall, when will they rebound?

items.more: Goldman Sachs lowered its 2027 price target to $4,650 per ounce, while UBS adjusted its 2026 target to $4,500, though both maintain higher long-term forecasts. The article notes that a sustained rebound likely depends on the US Federal Reserve shifting to a looser monetary policy, which is not expected to happen significantly before 2027. Consequently, prices are predicted to remain volatile and range-bound through the end of 2026.

items.zh: 英伟达恢复黄仁勋CEO职务
items.en: Nvidia (a major semiconductor company) restores Jensen Huang (its founder and CEO) to the position of CEO.
items.note: Nvidia announced that its board of directors has reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as its president, CEO, and director. The board stated that Huang remains the right leader for the company and that his return aligns with the best interests of shareholders and partners. Officials consulted with the U.S. government and determined that reinstating Huang does not pose a national security risk. Following the announcement, Nvidia's stock price surged significantly, contributing to a broader rebound in the U.S. stock market.

sources.name: China News Service
sources.title: 英伟达恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO及董事职务
sources.titleEn: Nvidia restores Jensen Huang's positions as president, CEO, and director

items.more: Huang had stepped down on November 12 following reports of extramarital affairs, but he will now face a closed-door inquiry by a U.S. House committee regarding export control compliance. U.S. President Trump publicly praised the board's decision as correct and responsible, noting he had communicated with the directors. The article notes that Huang has led the chipmaker for over 30 years and plays a key role in advancing artificial intelligence technology.

items.zh: 黄仁勋重返英伟达详尽始末
items.en: The detailed story of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
items.note: Nvidia announced that its board of directors has unanimously voted to restore Jensen Huang to his positions as President, Chief Executive Officer, and board member. The decision followed communications with Huang and consultations with high-level U.S. government officials who confirmed his return poses no national security risk. The board expressed approval of Huang's candor and leadership capabilities during this process. Huang stated he is honored to return and thanked his family, employees, and partners for their support.

sources.name: China News Service
sources.title: 黄仁勋回应重返英伟达
sources.titleEn: Jensen Huang responds to his return to Nvidia

items.more: The announcement was made on November 23 via Nvidia's official website. The board's vote was unanimous after reviewing input from U.S. authorities regarding national security concerns. Huang emphasized his commitment to assuming responsibility with humility. The article does not provide specific details on the prior reasons for his removal or the exact timeline of the interim period.

items.note: Marvel Studios has released a new trailer for the upcoming film Avengers: Doomsday. The movie is scheduled to premiere in China on December 16, ahead of its global release. The plot involves a multiverse collision that leads Doctor Doom to attempt to create a new universal order. The film reunites several major actors from the franchise under the direction of the Russo brothers.

While it opens in China on December 16, the North American release date is set for December 18, 2026.

items.en: Jensen Huang says he is honored to return to Nvidia
items.note: Nvidia announced that its board has reinstated CEO Jensen Huang to his position as president, CEO, and board member. The board reached this unanimous decision after holding discussions with Huang and expressing satisfaction with his honesty and leadership capabilities. Huang stated he is honored to return and lead the company during a new industrial revolution, pledging humility and renewed commitment. The company's stock price rose significantly in pre-market trading following the announcement.

Huang specifically thanked Chairman Harvey Jones, Colette Kress, and the executive team for their leadership during the interim period. He also expressed gratitude to employees, shareholders, partners, and his family for their support. The board cited Huang's candor and his ability to lead Nvidia as key factors in their decision to restore his duties.

items.zh: 扎堆产卵 同类相食！蝗虫诡异行为原理被中国科学家破解！【主播说三农】
items.en: Swarming to lay eggs and cannibalizing each other: The principle behind the bizarre behavior of locusts has been cracked by Chinese scientists! [Host Talks About Agriculture]

video.about: The video explains the scientific principles behind locusts' strange behaviors, such as clustering to lay eggs and cannibalism, as revealed by Chinese scientists.

reception.en: Commenters express amazement at the locust's complex survival mechanisms, comparing them favorably to other ancient creatures, while one user criticizes the video's pacing as inefficient for the information age. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“These mechanisms are too outrageous”
“Dragging it out for ten minutes”

comments.gist: The commenter lists the locust's traits like producing toxins, healing, recycling the injured, and using egg clusters to repel predators, calling it a world-ending disaster if not for its inability to survive cold.
The commenter states that locust evolution is excessive compared to dinosaurs, noting that while they have skills, they are superior to crocodiles who have learned nothing in ten thousand years.
The commenter complains that two knowledge points are expanded into ten minutes, asking who would watch such low-density videos in the information age.

items.zh: 【小跳蛙】|“【跳蛙の小曲】”
items.en: [Little Jumping Frog] | "[Jumping Frog's Little Song]"

video.about: The video features a puppet version of the song 'Little Jumping Frog,' with the puppets made by the uploader.

reception.en: Users express surprise that a children's song has gained popularity, with one comment criticizing the platform for recycling content from other apps. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“Came to Bilibili and haven't heard the original 10,000 yuan sound [crying]”
reception.zh: 来了B站还没听到过原版1万块钱的声音[大哭]

reception.en: “From Friend's Wine to Little Jumping Frog, I found Bilibili really has no life”
reception.zh: 从朋友的酒到小跳蛙，我发现 B 站真是没活了

comments.gist: The commenter states they have not heard the original sound associated with the song on Bilibili.
The commenter claims Bilibili is running out of content and is now using material left over from Douyin.
The commenter expresses shock that music from kindergarten is now trending.

items.zh: 我想回家吃饭（两小时大电影）
items.en: I want to go home to eat (a two-hour feature film)

video.about: The video is a two-hour long animation that the uploader celebrates completing.

reception.en: Commenters suggest changing the title to highlight the two-hour duration for better traffic, while one user notes the animation serves as a safe way to watch horror content. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“I want to watch a horror movie but dare not”
reception.zh: 我想看鬼片但是不敢看

comments.gist: The commenter.
The commenter states they missed the opportunity and should have saved the video for the Spring Festival.
The commenter says this animation solves the problem of wanting to watch a horror movie but being afraid to.

items.zh: 2026-2027国创动画作品发布会 全程回顾
items.en: 2026-2027 National Original Animation Works Press Conference: Full Review

video.about: The video is a full review of the 2026-2027 Chinese original animation product launch event hosted by Bilibili. It lists upcoming works that will be released on the Bilibili platform.

reception.en: Users are reacting with strong emotional attachment to specific series, describing them as integral parts of their lives. The comments focus on listing titles and expressing joy at the return of beloved franchises. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“It is good to be alive [crying]”
“The flesh of my palm and back of my hand”

comments.gist: A user provides a timestamped list of animated works announced in the video, including titles like The Three-Body Problem, Sword Dynasty, and Ling Cage.
A user lists several series and expresses that it is good to be alive, accompanied by a crying emoji.
A user mentions Ling Cage and The Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, describing them as precious flesh, accompanied by crying emojis.

items.zh: 《这波贪了》
items.en: "This Time I Greedily Took It"

video.about: The video is titled 'This time I got greedy' and has no description provided.

reception.en: Users discuss the video's content as a depiction of a scam involving fake appraisals and high estimates to trick participants, while one user accuses another of using a bot to copy comments. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“Real life has various shady auction houses running such scams”
reception.zh: 现实里各种野鸡拍卖行就是搞这样骗局的

comments.gist: The commenter states that in a future will, the eldest brother gets a house, the second gets land, and the third gets a smoking pipe.

The commenter explains that real-world shady auction houses run scams by claiming items are authentic, setting high estimates to collect participation fees, and then having the items fail to sell, often giving elderly people fake certificates.
The commenter claims that the Si Feng robot is copying comments again to gain likes.

items.zh: 我们成为英雄，哪怕只有一天
items.en: We Become Heroes, Even If Only for One Day

video.about: The video is a compilation set to various songs, including David Bowie's Heroes, that explores the theme of becoming a hero for a single day.

reception.en: Users praise the video for offering a heroic alternative to typical youth dramas and express nostalgia for a time when happiness came from small rebellions rather than academic pressure. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“This is the youth drama Chinese people should have”
reception.zh: 这才是国人应有的青春剧

reception.en: “Saying studying brings happiness is a lie”
reception.zh: 学习使人快乐都是骗人的

comments.gist: The commenter states that this meme provides creators with an alternative way to depict their youth using well-known figures.
The commenter argues that this content represents the proper youth drama for Chinese people, contrasting it with plots involving romance, abortion, dropping out, or music.
The commenter claims that the idea that studying brings happiness is false and that true happiness only comes from stealing time or secretly doing bad things.

items.zh: 对质
items.en: Confrontation

video.about: The video is a fan-made short film titled 'Confrontation' based on a Shakespeare quote, featuring original character designs and storyboarding by Angi.

reception.en: Viewers identify the character as Tomie rather than Misa, criticizing the latter's lack of independence, while others express humorous anxiety about the plot's escalating stakes. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“It is too obviously Tomie”
“The strongest spear and resurrection armor are on one monster”
reception.zh: 完了，最强的矛加最强的复活甲都集中在一个怪物上了

comments.gist: The commenter states that the strongest offensive weapon and the strongest defensive resurrection armor are now concentrated on a single monster.
The commenter argues the character is clearly Tomie because Misa is a stupid tool controlled by Light, whereas Tomie has the independent, arrogant execution shown in the scene.
The commenter repeats a phrase alternating between 'it is over' and 'it is good' to express chaotic anxiety about the situation.

items.zh: 🐧ai写 ai批 ai改🐧
items.en: AI writes, AI critiques, AI edits

video.about: The video uses the penguin emoji to represent AI and illustrates how AI is used to write, critique, and edit content. It draws a parallel between AI in game development and AI in academic writing.

reception.en: Users are reacting with humor and self-deprecation to the irony of AI being used for every stage of game development, mirroring its use in academic writing. They highlight the absurdity of multiple stakeholders demanding revisions without anyone actually doing the original work. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“AI writes, AI checks, AI reviews, then what about players?”
reception.zh: 写的是AI，查的是AI，批的是AI，那玩家呢

reception.en: “The AI writing the thesis in the video is my face.”
reception.zh: 片里那个趴在笔记本上写论文的 AI，就是我这张脸

comments.gist: The commenter notes that the term 'AAA' accurately describes a process where AI writes, checks, and reviews, leaving no role for the player.
The commenter identifies with the AI character in the video, stating that in the depicted scenario, no one touched paper.
The commenter describes a cycle where students, mentors, directors, and deans all demand revisions of the same work without anyone writing it themselves.
